description: This file implements ASN.1 object definitions and associated functions for RSADigestInfo, a structure used in SSL/TLS and cryptographic protocols to represent RSA digest information. It includes creation functions for the ASN.1 sequence and its child components (algorithm identifier and message digest), as well as metadata about the ASN.1 object.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_RSADIGESTINFO
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 Sequence object for RSADigestInfo, encapsulating algorithm identifier and message digest.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1CreateRSADigestInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new RSADigestInfo ASN.1 sequence object, setting its class name, sequence name, and child creation functions.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1RSADigestInfoCreateChildObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates the child ASN.1 objects for the sequence: either AlgorithmIdentifier or OctetString, based on index.

methods.name: PANSC_ATTR_OBJECT AnscAsn1RSADigestInfoCreateChildAttr(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates attribute objects for the child ASN.1 objects (not implemented in this snippet).

methods.name: PCHAR AnscAsn1RSADigestInfoGetChildName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Returns the name of the child component based on index (either 'algIdentifier' or 'messageDigest').
